Senses.Explanation: A mosquito on an iron ox meets a surface on which its mouth has nowhere to enter. The stock completion repeatedly says “there is nowhere for you to put down your mouth.” Masters deploy it as an answer, a blocking verdict, and a description of an encounter in which verbal purchase is unavailable; one lineage story contrasts being like the mosquito at Shitou with a later breakthrough under Mazu.
